text: As the Patriots prepare to face Kirk Cousins and the surging Raiders in Week 5, there's cautious optimism mixed with uncertainty along the roster, and you'll spot the team in throwback uniforms as they look to slow down one of the NFL's biggest offensive surprises. The injury report shows some relief with Rhamondre Stevenson returning to practice, though the running back position still carries question marks and Christian Gonzalez and Carlton Davis remain sidelined—but the real silver lining is the edge rusher trio of Dre'Mont Jones, Elijah Ponder, and rookie Gabe Jacas, who've been exceeding expectations in the first four games and should be central to containing Cousins' hot start. The team made a couple of roster moves this week, signing safety Mike Brown to the 53-man roster from the practice squad while adding linebacker Jose Ramirez to the practice squad, moves that suggest some depth shuffling as they navigate the injury landscape. The national experts are split on this one, though Stephen A. notably trusts the Patriots more than the Raiders heading into Sunday.
